description.value: Browns Socialhouse Fort St. John is a casual full-service chain restaurant situated in Fort St. John's commercial core, part of the Browns Restaurant Group with dozens of locations across BC and Alberta. The restaurant offers a social-house menu with weekend brunch service, making it one of the more substantial sit-down dining options in this northern BC community. Fort St. John sits along the Alaska Highway corridor, a key waypoint for cyclists undertaking long-distance northern routes.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the Fort St. John location at 9719 100TH ST with phone (250) 785 0885, both matching OSM tags; address and phone are corroborated. The site navigation prominently includes 'Order Delivery & Pickup', confirming takeout availability. No cycling-specific amenities—bike parking, water refill, or washroom access—are mentioned anywhere in the website content or OSM tags, and the business name on the website ('Browns Socialhouse', one word) differs slightly from the OSM entry ('Browns Social House', two words).
concerns: Name discrepancy: OSM records 'Browns Social House' (two words) but the business website consistently renders it as 'Browns Socialhouse' (one word).
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate full-service restaurant in a key northern BC cycling community, but none of the three required criteria (bike parking or visibility, water refill, washrooms) can be confirmed from available evidence; direct contact or a site visit is needed before including.
